annotations.title: Re-check one discoverability area after a fix

description: Re-check a single discoverability component after the person has fixed it. Use only once check_discoverability has reported that component failing and the person says the fix is done - never speculatively. Without a previous scan to compare against it returns NOT_READY. Inputs: domain (bare, like example.com) and component, one of crawl, plumbing, metadata, structured, answer - the identifier from the earlier scan's findings. Returns that component re-measured and the updated Discoverability score, so you can tell the person plainly whether the change worked. Always a live re-fetch, never served from cache, which is exactly why it beats a second check_discoverability straight after an edit. It draws on the discoverability fresh-scan budget for that domain (30 an hour, counted across all callers), so use a full check_discoverability instead when several areas changed. It only re-reads public pages; it changes nothing on the site.

domain.description: The domain to check, as the person gave it (no scheme, no path). Reserved names such as example.com are refused.

name: verify_fix

cache_age_seconds.description: Age of the result; 0 means it was scanned just now

items.description: One scored area of the domain

grade.description: A+ to F, or null alongside a null score

held_back.description: Points the cap holds back while a fix is open (89 cap) or a critical one is (69). Not taken from any component: sum(components.points) - held_back = score

inconclusive.description: The site could not be fetched, so the scan could not be completed. A failure to measure, not a finding about the site.

not_applicable.description: The domain publishes no web address, so there is no website to assess. Not a low score: score and grade are null and there are no recommendations. verdict names the domain to scan instead.

raw.description: What the components add up to, before the cap

reason.description: Why score is null, when it is

fix.description: The exact change to publish: a DNS record (name, type, value) or a file or tag (kind, label, value, where). Null when there is nothing to publish, for example "turn on DKIM in your provider".

report_url.description: The report page for this domain on astraverify.com

request_id.description: req_... for this call. Quote it when reporting a problem with the result.

score.description: Out of 100, exactly as astraverify.com shows it. Null when not_applicable or inconclusive is set.

verdict.description: One sentence on what engines can do with the site

verified_component.description: Set by verify_fix: the component re-checked

website_at.description: When the domain asked about serves no website but its registrable domain does, that domain's discoverability result. The score belongs to `domain` here, not to the domain in the request.

components.description: Component headlines only; scan this domain for the checks behind them

title: Re-check one discoverability area after a fix
